Get distinct elements.

Note: connected has atom_id and atom_id2. An atom in a double bond could be either position. So UNION of both.

SQL:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
ORDER BY a.element;
```
